method.referencePitchPolicy: Direct recorded keys only; sample-rate conversion preserves pitch and duration; no SFZ tuning or key-zone transposition.
method.onsetEnvelope: 4 ms power-RMS windows at 2 ms hops through 120 ms
method.transientSpectrum: five onset-aligned windows from 0–110 ms in 14 auditory bands
method.partials: up to 16 locally resolved stiff-string partials, tracked through all sustain windows
method.modulation: detrended narrowband fundamental envelope from 0.12–1.85 seconds
